svg.title: SedotDeck. Add it once. It stays up to date. Obtainium for Steam Deck: recomps, PC ports and emulators, updated and kept in your Steam library. 7 catalogs to browse and add from, 5 code hosts (GitHub, GitLab and more), no sudo: one Python file. Screenshots of My apps and Browse.
